notes: S3-FIX1 (decision 2026-11-17 #5), review A medium-3 R2 (§9.1 rule 3, §4.4 step 5, §14.5): a device declaration naming fix6-owner as its owner is signed only with the unknown algorithm ed25519-x. The owner's only declaration is cosigned by agent-1, a declared key that is not a trusted root: it supplies material, so the owner resolves, but it is not trusted (E_KEY_UNTRUSTED). Whether the owner is trusted needs no signature of the device declaration, so it is one of the other step-(7) rules and is reported instead of the step-5 E_SIG_UNVERIFIABLE. The Rust verifier reported E_SIG_UNVERIFIABLE before the fix (compare owner-resolves-device-unknown-algorithm-only, whose owner is trusted).
